name: hub
description: Local-first desktop hub for feeds, releases, game prices and novels, with an embedded browser, offline reading and automatic updates.
author: Minha Bolha (My Bubble)

scripts.dist: npm run icon && npm run build:api && npm run build -w @hub/web && npm run dist -w @hub/desktop && node scripts/make-portable.mjs
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @hub/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hub/api && npm run typecheck -w @hub/web
